title: Expository Writing — Writing to Explain
skills: define expository writing and explain its purpose
organize information clearly around a focused topic
develop explanations using relevant facts, examples, and details
use logical structure and transitions to improve clarity and coherence
alignment_note: Introduces expository writing as a form of writing used to explain ideas, information, and processes clearly. Supports informational writing, organization, evidence development, coherence, and audience-focused explanation across high school English courses.
